changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.7. In the machine list, UP, DOWN and the knobs A-H move the outline without loading; YES loads it, NO changes nothing. FUNC + DOWN jumps to the next section, FUNC + UP to the top of this section, then of the one above.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
